power_analysis.decision: cohort size is NOT adjusted to the power result. If the procedure yields fewer triggered datasets than required, the study is run anyway and the achieved power is reported.

effect_scenarios: 100% and 50% of the v2 dataset-level mean difference observed on the S04 cohort (50% = optimism discount)
inputs.sd: dataset-level SD of v2-v1 differences from the S04-cohort v2 artifacts, read at run time from files
inputs.trigger_rate: share of datasets with at least one triggered case in S04 (read from files)

power_analysis.method: Monte-Carlo simulation, 10000 replicates, executed and saved BEFORE the confirmatory run
outputs: power of H1 vs number of triggered datasets
minimum triggered datasets for 90% power under the 50% scenario
expected eligible cohort size = required triggered datasets / trigger_rate

primary_analyses.claim_rule: 'significant' only if the rule above is met; otherwise 'no significant difference detected' / 'not demonstrated'

primary_analyses.null_policy: a failed hypothesis is reported as a null finding; no re-run, no alternative configuration

secondary_analyses: selection-shift table: v1 choice x v2 choice with mean delta per cell, per dataset and per IR tercile
Oracle regret: bAcc(Oracle) - bAcc(v2) and - bAcc(v1)
negative control: replace the tie-break by a fixed-seed random choice and report the effect
leakage check: confirm every record has test_used_before_selection == false and recompute utility inputs from inner-split fields
REJECTED rate per variant (the balanced-accuracy gate is expected to be more selective than the accuracy gate)
gap to EasyEnsemble reported descriptively (no test, no claim)

author: Mohammed Qaid Al-Athwary
background: SRDF is a runtime framework for controlled structural adaptation. v2 of the framework (S06a+d) modified the Arbiter tie-break rule and replaced accuracy with balanced accuracy inside the utility signal. v2 was derived AFTER inspecting failures of v1 on the 45 S04 datasets; its effect on those datasets is therefore exploratory and optimistic by construction. This protocol specifies a confirmatory evaluation on a fully independent cohort.

cohort_specification.cohort_size: an outcome of the procedure, never a parameter; no first-N, no random sampling
cohort_specification.data_check: each dataset is re-downloaded and its data_sha256 must equal the S04 inspection record; mismatch => DATA_ERROR, recorded, not replaced
exclusions_in_order: any dataset whose data_sha256 equals that of a S04 cohort member (exact content duplicate)
any dataset sharing an OpenML name with a S04 cohort member (version families; independence rule)
exact-content duplicates within the remaining set (keep one by the S04 tier cascade)
cohort_specification.no_outcome_use: no model output of any version may enter cohort selection
cohort_specification.selection: apply the S04 deterministic primary-group and secondary-refinement procedure UNCHANGED (same bins, k1/k2 rules, tier cascade, diversity step, coverage audit, independent audit) to the remaining set
cohort_specification.universe: S04 eligibility_table.csv rows with eligible == True (frozen OpenML snapshot; no re-query of OpenML metadata)

estimands.E1: mu1 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(v1)]
estimands.E2: mu2 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(Always-SMOTE+RF)]
estimands.E3: mu3 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(RF baseline)]  (replication of the S04 effect)
estimands.case_inclusion: cases with training IR >= 3.0 for which BOTH compared variants produced a committed structure; NOT_TRIGGERED never counted as zero; REJECTED reported separately
estimands.unit: dataset (mean over the SUCCESS cases of the dataset); case-level results are descriptive only

execution_plan.metric: balanced accuracy on the held-out fold
execution_plan.selection_data: inner validation split of the training partition only (test fold untouched until the structure is fixed)
variants_run_on_every_case: Oracle (better of the two library candidates, evaluated on the test fold; diagnostic only, never used for selection)

how_to_cite: Cite the OSF/Zenodo DOI together with the SHA-256 of S06_PROTOCOL.json as recorded in the deposit.
